headline: Ukraine Attacks Terminal in Russia After Putin-Trump Diesel Deal
summary: Ukraine attacked an oil terminal in Russia's Rostov region after Russian and US presidents announced a diesel supply agreement, Russian authorities said. Russia responded with guided bombs on Zaporizhzhia.
why: Attacks on oil infrastructure can disrupt Russian fuel exports and affect global diesel supply, a key concern for energy markets and refiners.
why_moved: A strike on an oil terminal in southern Russia came just after a diesel supply agreement between the Russian and US presidents was announced.
